newsitem.title: USA: Intel ups buyback program to 140 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Intel ups buyback program to 140 mln shrs.

text.p: Intel Corp said Thursday it approved an increase of up to 30 million shares in its common stock repurchase program, bringing the total authorization to 140 million shares.
With the share increase, and after reserving for outstanding put warrants, 39.9 million shares remain available for repurchase under the authorization, Intel said.
Under the the stock repurchase program, started in 1990, the computer chip company has repurchased and retired about 92.6 million shares at a cost of $4.6 billion.

Intel said its previously announced two-for-one stock split is subject to the condition that the stockholders approve an increase in total authorized shares of common stock from the current limit of 1.4 billion shares to 4.5 billion.
Intel stockholders will vote on the increase at the company's annual meeting scheduled for May 21.
Following the stock split, the company said the total repurchase authorization would be 280 millio shares.
